methodology.provider_identity: Furas source_opportunity_id == official OPPORTUNITYID; unique within the Furas source.
methodology.candidate_generation: Indexed source-reference equality, indexed normalized core-title equality, current-Master reference/title indexes, then exact source identity resolver feature checks; same-source review uses indexed repeated-title/site/coordinate groups. No all-pairs cross-source fuzzy join.
methodology.auto_match_policy: Only current resolver auto_merge_safe or a trusted exact official reference without conflict can be high-confidence. Title similarity alone, shared publisher, city, sector, or municipality never authorizes a link.
methodology.national_eligibility: A nationwide itemized Announced Furas listing with an official ID/detail identity is not gated by Al-Ahsa relevance.
methodology.geography: Use exact Furas REGIONNAME/CITYNAME and source point only. AMANA is retained as the issuer/administrative authority, not treated as a Governorate. No reverse-geocoding or inferred labels.
methodology.field_precedence: No existing Master fields are changed. Existing values remain canonical; source evidence and raw Furas fields are retained. Furas dates and duration stay unverified/raw-only under accepted semantics.
methodology.unverified_source_flag: QUALIFYINGOPPORTUNITY=0 was selected by the source query. Its field semantics are not used alone to reject a row; the official opportunity type, Announced status, provider ID, title, and detail URL are independently present.
methodology.promotion_guard: This artifact contains proposals only. It performs no Master creation, linking, merge, source sync, or UI/map activation.

simulation.field_precedence: No values overwrite existing canonical Master data in this simulation. Proposed linked groups preserve source observations; conflicts stay in review.
simulation.geography_projection_guard: A future implementation must not reuse the current national normalized_record() Al-Ahsa city fallback. Use exact source CITYNAME when present, otherwise an unspecified city label, and persist explicit Furas coordinate provenance without inventing a governorate/region reference.

geography_distribution.governorate_reason: No dedicated governorate field or approved national reference mapping is present; AMANA labels are not substituted.
geography_distribution.interpretation: Region/city counts are direct Furas field values grouped as supplied, not boundary-derived administrative assignments. Records lacking one of these labels retain source points and any other raw location text.

taxonomy_distribution.interpretation: Use only the current source-scoped mappings. Investment remains unspecified in the current Opportunity Type taxonomy; TemporaryRental maps to تأجير مؤقت. Activity/sub-activity remain distinct from sector and asset type. No new taxonomy categories are proposed.

lifecycle_distribution.interpretation: Absence from Job 694 alone is not treated as cancellation. Existing source lifecycle evidence is retained; the one active row with one absence is low-confidence non-current and is not called removed.
